name: Ramanujan Fellowship
funder: Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF, formerly SERB), DST, Government of India
amount: Rs 1,35,000/month consolidated (incl. HRA) + Rs 7 lakh/year research grant + Rs 60,000/year overhead to host
other_rules: Indian citizens or persons of Indian origin (OCI/PIO) are eligible
must be below 40 years of age
must be working abroad at the time of nomination
must not hold a permanent, tenure-track or contractual position in any Indian institution
cannot be hosted at the institution where the PhD was obtained
cannot be nominated by own PhD supervisor
PhD, MD or M.Tech/ME or equivalent accepted
notes: Rolling nominations for 2026 accepted until 31 Dec 2026, 5 PM IST; results announced twice a year. Nominee fills form on anrfonline.in and sends it to the nominator (head of host institution), who submits. Not extendable. Fellowship ends if fellow takes any salaried position in India. Must join within 6 months of award. One international trip per year allowed. Fellows can later apply for the 2-year SERB Research Scientist scheme.
